name: Szervusz, Szergej
overview: Sergei, the pure-hearted clown, has a sworn enemy in the evil Stablemaster, as both of them are in love with Cecilia, the beautiful clown girl. Tender feelings begin to blossom between Sergei and Cecilia, but in order to prevent their relationship from continuing, the Stablemaster writes a slanderous letter to the girl. He claims that Sergei is not sincere with her.
